profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a seasoned Software Engineer with extensive experience in building scalable, distributed systems, and leading high-impact financial technology projects. My expertise spans cloud-native architectures, microservices, data processing pipelines, and performance optimization across major financial institutions, including US Bank and JPMorgan.

At US Bank, I led the development of a high-performance Webhook Platform that processes over 1 million financial events monthly, ensuring secure, reliable data delivery to partners. Leveraging technologies like Apache Kafka, Cassandra, Spring Boot, Kubernetes (k8s), and Istio service mesh, I created a subscription model enabling seamless partner onboarding with various security protocols (Basic Auth, OAuth, JWT, TLS/mTLS). Additionally, I implemented Open-Banking APIs handling 3000 TPS and optimized system performance through Redis caching and resiliency patterns, resulting in significant performance gains.

At JPMorgan, I spearheaded the design and implementation of Credit Card Recovery solutions, generating over $10 million in monthly revenue. I implemented distributed batch processes using Kafka and Spring Boot to process more than 15 million delinquent customer records daily, delivering personalized offers. I also enhanced Oracle data load performance by 5x through SQL*Loader and Spark batch optimization.

With a strong focus on cloud infrastructure, I set up AWS services (EKS, RDS, Lambda, S3, SQS) using Terraform modules and conducted proof-of-concept work for AWS Glue and Apache Geode (Gemfire), resulting in cost reduction and a 10x performance improvement.

My leadership and hands-on technical expertise in cloud migration, data processing, and financial services technology make me passionate about driving innovation and delivering scalable solutions that impact millions of users. I'm always focused on pushing the boundaries of technology to create efficient, high-performance systems.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
> Designed and built a scalable Webhook Platform using Apache Kafka, Cassandra, Spring Boot microservices, Apigee Gateway, Kubernetes, and Istio service mesh. This platform securely processes over 1 million financial events monthly with guaranteed delivery to US Bank partners.
> Developed a subscription model for the Webhook Platform, enabling seamless partner onboarding with diverse security protocols such as Basic Auth, OAuth, JWT, TLS, and mTLS.
> Designed and developed Open-Banking APIs, handling 3000 transactions per second (TPS) for integrations with fintech companies, banks, payment vendors, government entities, and merchants.
> Achieved ~10x faster data reads by implementing Write-thru and Read-thru Redis caching with the SAGA transaction pattern, ensuring data consistency across multiple databases.
> Integrated resiliency patterns such as exponential retries, circuit breakers, and multi-region deployment with WideIP to enhance system stability.
> Designed loosely coupled architecture using Istio sidecar Envoy filters, streamlining common functionality (e.g., Authentication/Authorization), saving an estimated three sprints per API.
> Implemented OpenTelemetry with Prometheus and Spring Boot micrometer to monitor operational metrics, including Kafka event latency and throughput (p90, p95, p99).
> Led a Proof of Concept on Corda Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT) for Smart Contracts, driving innovation in financial technology.
> Oversaw the Azure cloud migration for all on-premise microservices and applications, ensuring a smooth transition.
> Led a team, ensuring adherence to coding standards and providing technical leadership throughout project execution.

positions.title: Vice President
positions.description:
> Led the design and implementation of a Credit Card Recovery system, generating over $10 million in monthly revenue through personalized offers for delinquent customers.
> Built distributed batch processing systems using Kafka and Spring Boot to handle over 15 million delinquent customer records daily, enabling efficient offer generation and customer engagement.
> Enhanced Oracle data load performance by 5x through the implementation of SQL*Loader and Spark batch processing, significantly reducing processing time.
> Designed and deployed AWS infrastructure using Terraform modules, creating services such as EKS, RDS, Lambda, S3, and SQS to support cloud-native applications.
> Conducted a Proof of Concept (POC) for AWS Glue, demonstrating its ability to replace on-prem Spark jobs and reduce operational costs.
> Set up Kubernetes resources for managing Spark jobs, enabling scalable data processing in cloud environments.
> Led a POC for Apache Geode (Gemfire), improving in-memory caching performance by 10x, optimizing application response times and throughput.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
> Led the design and delivery of applications for capturing attestations and control issues related to firm-wide financial and regulatory reports.
> Collaborated closely with the Product Owner to define the product roadmap, create user stories, prioritize tasks, and assign responsibilities to the team.
> Built a front-end application using ReactJS, with extensive use of ag-Grid for high-performance data handling and visualization.
> Developed and integrated REST APIs to facilitate seamless communication between systems, ensuring smooth data flow across multiple applications.
> Designed and implemented database schemas, stored procedures, and queries in Oracle 19c to optimize data storage and retrieval.
> Remediated security issues identified by SonarQube, Snyk, and Black Duck scans, ensuring compliance with the firm's security standards.
> Configured Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF) environments for deploying applications, enhancing scalability and performance.
> Developed CI/CD pipelines using Jules (built on Jenkins), automating application builds, testing, and deployments.
> Automated database migration processes using Liquibase/Flyway to streamline version control and updates.
> Configured monitoring tools like AppDynamics and Splunk for application performance tracking and error logging.
> Mentored junior developers, conducted code reviews, and provided technical guidance to ensure adherence to best practices and coding standards.
